> Statutory Holidays Amendment Act 2026

An Act to amend the _Statutory Holidays Act 2000_

\[Royal Assent 9 October 2026\]

Be it enacted by Her Excellency the Governor of Tasmania, by and with the advice and consent of the Legislative Council and House of Assembly, in Parliament assembled, as follows:

**1.** **Short title**

> This Act may be cited as the [Statutory Holidays Amendment Act 2026](https://www.legislation.tas.gov.au/view/html/inforce/2026-10-09/act-2026-018) .

**2.** **Commencement**

> This Act commences on the day on which this Act receives the Royal Assent.

**3.** **Principal Act**

> In this Act, the [Statutory Holidays Act 2000](https://www.legislation.tas.gov.au/view/html/inforce/2026-10-09/act-2000-096) is referred to as the Principal Act.

_**4.**_

_> The amendment effected by this section has been incorporated into the authorised version of the [Statutory Holidays Act 2000](https://www.legislation.tas.gov.au/view/html/inforce/2026-10-09/act-2000-096) ._

**5.** **Repeal of Act**

> This Act is repealed on the first anniversary of the day on which it commenced.
